Senses.Explanation: Xiao He is the historical official invoked in the allusion that he made the laws. Beishan says ‘Xiao He made the laws’ after judging two figures; Langting Jingting says ‘Xiao He did not make the laws’ in a sequence undoing familiar attributions; Baofu Congzhan uses the related formula ‘Xiao He set up the laws.’ The name therefore carries the legal allusion in these cases.
